objection.quote: - Upper bound: Xiang Yu can limit Liu Bang to at most (n+1)/(2n+1). Strategy for X?
objection.witness: Missing statement: for every Liu division into at most n+1 pieces, a construction of at most n additional Xiang cuts forcing Liu's alternating-sum total down to c (e.g. subset-sum pigeonhole plus a cancellation/overlay construction). The quoted line explicitly asks for such a strategy rather than giving one, and the 'Full proof' section reads '(To be completed)'.
objection.load_bearing: Without any Xiang strategy the maximality of c is entirely unsupported; the text itself flags this as an open task.
